about: Public metabolomics studies gathered for validating the interpretation of the user's own data, and as the published examples behind the application's worked-example library. Fetch them with tools/validation/fetch_metabolomics.sh; everything here was read from the Metabolomics Workbench REST API, not from memory.
source: Metabolomics Workbench (NIH Common Fund), https://www.metabolomicsworkbench.org — each study also has its own DOI and terms; check them before redistributing the data

studies.design: wild type and three regulator knockouts (WT, FA, FI, AI), 6 replicates each, anaerobic fermentation
studies.measures: intracellular: 18 amino acids, NAD, NADPH, GABA
studies.whyItMatters: the only one in absolute amounts per gram dry weight, the same basis the application uses, and iML1515 is in the catalogue. The primary test case for the intracellular side.

studies.design: MPC11 myeloma cells, control against methionine restriction (0.5 mg/L), three time points (24, 48, 120 h), 9 replicates per group
studies.whyItMatters: the richest panel and the cleanest design: a single nutrient removed, with a time course and real replicates. Methionine restriction has an expected signature (methionine, the transsulfuration route, polyamines) to check the hypotheses against.

studies.design: INS-1 832/13 cells, buthionine sulfoximine (BSO) against control, in medium with and without 2-mercaptoethanol
studies.whyItMatters: BSO inhibits one known enzyme, glutamate-cysteine ligase (GCLC), so the cause is known in advance: the ideal case for the bottleneck detector. GCLC was also one of the systematic false positives of the DepMap comparison.

studies.design: wild type against mtl1 (YGR023W) deletion, 13 cultures each, with OD600 recorded per sample
studies.whyItMatters: one metabolite only, so it is useless for a network analysis, but glucose in mM together with OD600 per culture is exactly the input of the exometabolomics rate calculation. A small, real test of that path on yeast-GEM.

studies.design: spent medium of HEK293: fresh medium, wild type, wild type with antimycin A, and an SDHAF2 mutant with antimycin A, 3 replicates each
studies.measures: lactate in the medium, against an inositol internal standard
studies.whyItMatters: only lactate, but the design is pointed: fresh medium as the starting point (the exometabolomics layout), a complex III inhibitor and a succinate dehydrogenase assembly mutant. It touches the same enzyme as the SDHB work in this project, and the cells are HEK293, like Dietmair 2012.

alsoSeen.note: CCLE metabolomics across hundreds of cell lines. Not a two-condition design, so it does not fit the contrast analysis, but it pairs with the DepMap comparison already in the repository: one metabolome per line, for the same lines.

notFit.note: kept separately as tools/validation/dietmair2012_intracellular.json: 52 metabolites, HEK293 producer against non-producer, and the same paper's Table 2 is the application's hek293 measured exchange set.
